parole.significato: windsock; a bag- or sausage-shaped pennant used to indicate wind direction
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dutch waker (“wind indicator; buoy”) or Low German waker (“wind indicator; buoy”). The source noun is derived from the nautical verb waken (“to float; remain above water”), which is etymologically the same word as waken (“to be awake; keep watch”). The verb continues Middle Dutch wāken
